name: level rating
description: N12.2: does the player's club have an edge in the match itself at a level rating (the re-baseline's +3.8 a game within 2 points)? Each seed a new game's squad (Normal) through its opening lineup against a rival's generated squad level with its best nine, through the rival coach's auto-pick, as matchday.ts builds them: both ways round, with the rival's AI coach, with the rival on a plan, with no traits, with no bench, two rival squads as the control, and the player's squad with its star swapped for a first-grader (the squad's shape). homeMargin and nine are in results.jsonl.

scenarios.name: player v rival, rival AI coach
player v rival, rival on kick-chase / rush
player without his star v rival
rival v player without his star
